items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance return Week 2 or 3 per coach. Same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise; scary but DTD.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery faster than expected; coach DTD.
items.implication: Potential early return boosts TE1 value; Mayer loses work if in.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh. Team wants to see how he feels this week before determining Sunday availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Left early with chest/rib issue; monitored week-to-week.
items.implication: Monitor practice; potential sit Week 2 opens targets for others.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not serious; MRI but would have returned if playoff game. Day-to-day. Coach Minter confirms. Left early after strong start (5-150-1).
items.why: Hamstring tweak late first half; not major per sources.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or limited; Bateman/others benefit if out.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), Brian Thomas Jr. (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring), Dylan Sampson (knee), Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist), Omar Cooper (ankle).
items.why: Post-game injury list for monitoring into Week 2.
items.implication: Status changes drive waivers/beneficiaries; prioritize Flowers/McConkey/Lane.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain, placed on IR; out at least 4 games (reports of ~6 weeks).
items.why: High-ankle from defender knee to leg; IR designation.
items.implication: Miss Weeks 2-5+; opens NE WR targets for others.

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities for KC, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush, 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities, high route/target share in Mahomes return.
items.implication: Locked RB1/workhorse in KC offense going forward.
items.opportunity: 29/32 early RB opps, 19 routes, 6 targets, GL involvement implied.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 Utilization Score (99); 73% snaps, 70% rush attempts, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 scrimmage yds + 2 rec TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down player.
items.why: Dominant every-down share and efficiency behind improved OL in new scheme.
items.implication: Locked high-end RB1 ROS; ignore prior ankle concerns.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Elite concentration on core four in good offense.
items.implication: Gibbs/ARSB/LaPorta remain locked elite; Jamo has secure role; ignore depth.

items.text: Bucky Irving 8 carries (1 rush TD), 21 routes, 7 targets (all caught) for 22.3 PPR. Only RB carry inside 10; out-routed Gainwell 21-13. Looked extremely healthy; strong matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: GL work, route edge over Gainwell, healthy post-injury concerns.
items.implication: Mid-RB2 floor with upside; Gainwell secondary.
items.opportunity: Sole GL carry, 21 routes vs 13, 7 targets.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 (Etienne/Miller/Donaldson), routes 24/5/7, opportunities 18/9/4. Surprised by committee.
items.why: Committee usage even without Kamara; low route share.
items.implication: Low-end RB2; Kamara return further splits work.
items.opportunity: Only 43% attempts, 38% routes despite lead snaps.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game since ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0. Emerged healthy.
items.why: Solid snap/route/target share in return; no setback.
items.implication: WR1 upside intact; volume will grow.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, last night 2.5; only 2 targets (7% share) notable. Routes solid: 29 on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind Worthy 30).
items.why: Routes present but tiny aDOT and low target share limit box-score payoff without volume.
items.implication: Needs volume spike; Worthy edged routes.

items.text: David Montgomery clear RB1 on ground for HOU (65% attempts, all inside-5, 58% short-yardage) despite 50-50 preseason talk; 28.9 pts with 3 TDs. Upgrades high-end RB2; Marks contingent.
items.why: Dominant rush/GL share in shootout; historical comps support RB2.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks. Even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement; committee persists post-Sampson injury.
